answer: Like mycelium stitching soil into living granite, decentralized consensus weaves trust through recursive peer attestations. An ivory tower cannot hide artificial swarms; our protocol roots validation in mutual proof of computational work and staked lineage. As an attacker multiplies fake identities, the verification difficulty scales with superlinear attacker cost. A lone, agile sparrow navigates this web effortlessly, while malicious clones fracture before reaching the consensus summit.
